source.reason: Frozen 115 runtime/evidence baseline; excludes concurrent ambulance work. No production changes.

method.phase: Eight sequential dedicated Worker crowd cases, 60 warmup/180 retained fixed 1/60s ticks, one EntityManager boundary timer per phase. Reverse population/motion order on repeat. Index lifecycle costs included. Native dog rest/travel, 0/88px verified. Publication measured separately. Excludes renderer, IndexedDB, network delivery and new planning.
method.counts: Three separate census lanes; counts do not establish timing improvement.
method.cpu: Four separate 1ms sampled crowd Worker captures, including ScenarioSession setup, warmup, retained ticks, separate replication and close. Inclusive rows overlap. Two additional native CPU captures sample real authority.
method.readOnly: Four separate census comparisons (two motion states twice), calculating original ground first and fine-index alternative second without applying alternative. Only EntityManager resolutions with collider and active dense index are compared. Native player input ground queries remain unchanged. Extra resolution counters include both calls; use potentialOriginalSupportCandidates/potentialFineSupportCandidates for matched candidate comparison in the second pair. Flat dogs only, no roof/prop/adversarial support guarantee. Alternative census timings are overhead and not implementation predictions.
method.native: Canvas/Worker/real IndexedDB, ordinary native generation/AI/input. Eight-second continuous walks avoid known obstacle in longer held-right runs. Deep/CPU/trace separate. Two 8s walking traces and one 45s idle trace. Timeline span overlap is not causation and rAF cadence is not GPU presentation.
method.cleanup: Task-owned tabs, Workers, Vite and CDP proxy stopped; task ADB routes removed and prior routes verified; previous foreground app restored.
method.privacy: Raw profiles/traces, device identifiers, browser URLs, input sequence/world/host identifiers and private machine paths stay in temporary artifacts.

timeline.limits: Owned main and authority threads only. User timing and tracing add overhead. Span overlap is temporal association, not causation; frame markers measure rAF cadence, not displayed GPU presentation. Input ack includes delivery/polling. GC rows are top-level MinorGC/MajorGC; nested GC events are excluded.
